Scheduling lane: closed. Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19: Acceptance consolidated into canonical clock integration bd-01M2WTGF981AY7RCN8QC42JSPT. This closure removes duplicate scheduling, not implementation work.

Historical finding and scope retained below; current acceptance ownership above governs.

Close the parent with evidence.

1. Re-run the baseline command on the same admitted inputs. The output digest and the MediaLocus digest must match the baseline receipt byte for byte. The arithmetic is identical, so ANY difference is a defect, not a tolerance question.
2. Mutations, each asserted to have applied, run in a cleaned test scope: revert locusFor to hand arithmetic; feed the wrong run's repair; drop a run's repair (must refuse via the no-repair overload); change a measurement in the JSON (must refuse, or move the manifest, per the record bead).
3. Gate command from tools/reference-scope.sh, pasted not retyped; bound TEST TOTALS (SD2); scalafmtCheckAll last and separately.
4. Cold review in a separate pass (SD6). The finding behind this bead came from one.
set.title: C1: verify -- byte-identical sherlockRecallMap output against the baseline, mutations, gate, cold review
